name: Ming-3.0-asr-tiny

lineage.base_model: Ling-tiny-v3 language backbone plus an audio encoder (card)

purpose: Context-aware speech recognition for Chinese, English and regional dialects; hotwords or preceding dialogue can be put into the prompt to improve domain terms (card).

license.name: MIT
license.notes: LICENSE read: MIT, Copyright 2026 inclusionAI. Bundled Apache-2.0 source files and Whisper-derived encoder code keep their own notices.

architecture.kind: MoE language backbone (128 routed experts, 8 active, 1 shared; MLA-style kv_lora_rank 512; 24 layers, hidden 1536; MTP layer in config) with Whisper-style audio encoder (hidden 1280)
architecture.recurrent: KDA-style linear attention settings in the config (kda_safe_gate, short_conv_kernel_size 4); exact layer mix not stated on the card

pc-12gb.notes: 17.8 GB in BF16 without an official quant; MoE with small active size would allow RAM offload

mac-16-24gb.notes: BF16 17.8 GB against the 12 or 22 GB GPU share

engine_support.notes: Card: example does not support streaming input; output has no timestamps or diarization.

strengths: 15 Chinese dialect test sets evaluated by the builder
weaknesses: Chinese and English only: no German
Evaluation results are published only as images in the card (not readable as numbers here)
No word timestamps, no speaker diarization, no streaming input
soft.maturity: Ant Group Ming family, first release 2026-10.

tona_fit.reason: Chinese and English only; no German. Listed for completeness of the Ming 3.0 family and its context-ASR idea (hotwords in the prompt) that German-capable ASR models may copy.

open_questions: Numeric WER/CER values (card shows images only)
Exact layer mix of the linear-attention backbone
